(a) Rotavirus is an important cause of diarrhoeic disease in young foals in Greece, (b) Rotavirus infection was associated with severe diarrhoea, dehydration, and weight loss in young foals, and (c) Rotavirus infection in foals was associated with the circulation of the same rotavirus strain in the same stud farm for two consecutive breeding periods.
